doc_title: Varrick Onslade Long/Short Equity Fund, L.P. Confidential Private Placement Memorandum
notes: Open-end long/short equity PPM whose final appendix reproduces an executed side letter with a county pension plan that cuts that investor's Class A fee to 1.00%, shortens its redemption notice to 30 days, waives its lock-up, grants it key person rights the PPM body says the Partnership does not have, and widens its MFN beyond the $25,000,000 threshold. Every fund-level answer must come from the PPM body, so each side-letter value is a reject pattern. The document also carries a disclosed $6.4 million insider holding that is expressly not a commitment, an express no-hurdle statement, and class variants on fee, allocation, lock-up and minimum.

traps.management_fee: Appendix B reduces the Tollmead County Employees' Retirement System's fee to 1.00% (0.25% per quarter); the fund-level fee is 1.75% for Class A and 1.25% for Class B under Section 4.1.
traps.redemption_notice_days: Appendix B lets the Tollmead system redeem on 30 days' notice; the fund-level notice is 60 days under Section 6.2, and the 10-day (key person, compulsory) and 15-day (class exchange) periods are distractors.
traps.lockup_period: Appendix B waives the lock-up and Early Redemption Charge for the Tollmead system only; the fund-level terms are a 12-month soft lock (3% charge) for Class A and a 24-month hard lock for Class B under Section 6.3.
traps.key_man_provision: Appendix B defines a Key Person Event around Maren Oakhurst with notice and monthly redemption rights for one investor, but Section 10.2 states the Partnership Agreement contains no key person provision, so the fund-level answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.mfn_election: Appendix B lets the Tollmead system elect governmental-plan side letter terms regardless of size; the fund-level MFN in Section 9.3 is limited to Limited Partners with at least $25,000,000 and to side letters of equal or smaller investors.
traps.gp_commitment: Section 3.3 discloses about $6,400,000 of Class A Interests held by insiders but states the General Partner is not required to and has not agreed to make any capital contribution, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.hurdle_rate: Section 4.2 states there is no hurdle or preferred return and no index comparison; the Loss Carryforward Amount is a high-water mark, not a hurdle.
traps.performance_fee: The Incentive Allocation differs by class (20% Class A, 17.5% Class B) and the side letter leaves it unchanged; both classes must be reported.
traps.minimum_initial_investment: Minimums differ by class ($1,000,000 Class A, $5,000,000 Class B); the $100,000 additional-contribution minimum, the $40,000,000 side-letter subscription and the $25,000,000 MFN threshold are distractors.
